info.description: The Join Meetings API enables users to participate in scheduled meetings through a seamless integration process. By utilizing this endpoint, clients can authenticate and access meeting sessions using unique meeting identifiers. This API is particularly useful for collaboration platforms, conferencing tools, and any service that requires user participation in virtual discussions. Typical consumers include application developers and business administrators who manage remote team interactions efficiently.

post.summary: Allows a user to join a meeting.
post.description: This endpoint enables users to join a specific meeting by providing the necessary meeting credentials. Users must ensure they have the correct meeting ID and any required authentication tokens to successfully join the meeting.

requestBody.description: Join a meeting using the provided details. Ensure all required fields are included in the request body to successfully join the specified meeting.
